summary: The 3D render quality is consistent with clean character modeling and pleasant outdoor environments. Text cards and board templates are clear, though some text layouts feel slightly misaligned across shots.

clean: Character shapes, floating hands, and props maintain consistent aesthetic rules throughout.
Gourd props align properly with character hands during holding poses.
unclean: Shot 5: Green shirt figure has floating hands positioned wide without holding any props, creating an awkward stance.

clean: Text cards match frame contrast well and use readable typography.
Lighting and environment colors remain vibrant and bright.
unclean: Shot 8: Text elements on the board slide are placed too low and small near the bottom corner.

issues.problem: Board text is tiny and placed near bottom margin.
issues.fix: Center and enlarge lower graphic text for better legibility.

issues.problem: Hands float passively in the air without clear context.
issues.fix: Add a pose or gesture to make hand placement look intentional.

learnings.rule: Keep graphic text centered and safely within vertical UI margins.
Avoid T-pose or wide floating hand placements when characters hold no props.
